items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: And then back on the Lenfance side of the tracks was the Starbright Inn, Sam Sires, Starbright Inn. Which was a hangout for one of them.

ctx.x: Muffins was on the railroad track. They had a place across, on the same side of Canal Boulevard, but across the tracks from Muffins called the Wishing Well. And then across the street from that, on the same side of the tracks, was where Fazola played. And then back on the Lenfance side of the tracks was the Starbright Inn, Sam Sires, Starbright Inn. Which was a hangout for one of them.
